narrative.text: The annual report presents a strong foundation characterized by zero bank borrowings, healthy operating cash flows, and steady software and IT consulting revenue [0.15, 0.20]. Recent concalls align with this operational health, reporting FY26 revenue of $1.65 billion and robust growth in verticals like BFSI [2.2, 3.5, 3.9]. However, management's emphasis on recent calls has shifted toward aggressive external expansion and platform-led growth, marked by an agreement to acquire Nagarro for €1.27 billion using bridge financing and filing 105 patents for its SASVA platform [2.10, 2.13, 4.10].
